context.research_question: Can exact-center EPG navigation recover two global T2 curves and preserve the strict radial TSE targets across the measured local uncertainty stress cases?
context.target_rationale: Retain 1e-6 image/component and 1e-10 data targets. Fit only the first four navigator echoes, withhold the last two echoes and interleaved repeats, and compare a fixed-prior inverse on the identical acquired samples. Select only candidates passing every scenario and total preparation plus acquisition RF limits.
context.assumptions: Synthetic parent; calibrated disjoint global T2 intervals and authored T1/PD. Six echoes and 33-point center-sampled spokes are explicit acquisition changes. Navigation is not voxel T2 mapping, image gain fitting or clinical confidence coverage.
